title: The First Jumu`ah of Holy Muharram: Ask for a Sultan
body:
Dastoor yaa Sayyiddee. Madad yaa RijaalAllah. (Mawlana Shaykh stands) Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, laa
ilaaha illa-Llah, Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, wa lillahi 'l-hamd! Allahuma salli wa sallim wa baarik `alaa
Sayyidi 'l-Awwaleen wa ’l-Akhireen, Sayyidina Muhammad wa man tabi`ahum bi ihsaan ila Yawm ad-Deen.
Thumma as-salaat was-salaam `alaykum yaa anbiya-Allah, yaa `ibaadAllah as-saaliheen. (Mawlana Shaykh
sits) Allahuma innee da`eefun fee maqaam ad-da`f, yaa Allah. I am a weak servant. O our Lord! Give me as
You like. And we are saying, a`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytani 'r-rajeem. Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem.
(Mawlana Shaykh stands) Wa laa hawla wa laa quwatta illa billahi 'l-`Aliyyu 'l-`Azheem. (Mawlana Shaykh
sits)
As-salaamu `alaykum, yaa `ibaadAllah! As-salaamu `alaykum, our attenders! This is an honored meeting or
association. We are not asking for honor from people, no! You must ask for honor from the Lord of Heavens,
Jalla Jalaaluh. Here there is a small group from the servants of the Lord of Heavens, and no doubt today is
Friday, Yawm al-Jumu`ah, the most honored and glorified day in this life and in Paradise also! Millions of
Muslims are running to mosques for Jumu`ah prayers, which are the most honored prayers, even more than
the prayers of `Eid al-Fitr and `Eid al-Adha, the two days that Allah Almighty granted, and such is the honor
of the day of Jumu`ah. Tooba, good tidings, that there the most honor is given to those who are looking after

and taking care of Jumu`ah.

SubhaanAllah! Now all Muslim nations are mostly not taking enough care for the honor of this most
honored day, Yawm al-Jumu`ah. They are working, and millions of people are not taking care to give honor
to Jumu`ah, Friday. Really we are not giving honor, but we are taking honor from the Lord of Heavens,
because we are giving high respect for this holy day. Now you may go around and so many millions of people
are working, but those who are working on Friday (without pausing to attend Jumu`ah prayer) are workers
of Shaytan! Those who are coming for Jumu`ah prayers have been honored by Allah Almighty. Those who
are not taking care and giving honor are followers of Shaytan, and Shaytan is making their faces ugly!
O People throughout the east and west! Leave false and untrue ways and beliefs! There is only one belief that
the Seal of Prophets (s) brought and taught people, and it is honor for you to keep that. Beyond that, all of
them are dishonoring. Shaytan is trying to make people's faces ugly here and Hereafter. There is coming from
those who are praying Jumu`ah prayers such a uns (familiarity) from the Heavens. Those who are not
coming from the Muslims communities, their faces are going to be ugly and more ugliness is a sign that their
inner lives are in trouble. Before, people took care for Jumu`ah, particularly ummat al-Habeeb (s), the
Prophet's nation, and now they left it, saying, "We have so much business to complete." No one before them
completed this world's work or business; rather, all of them left it half complete and going away.
O People! Try to believe. If you like to reach a sweet life in this life, try to believe! Those who believe may
taste sweetness. Who is asking for a sweet life must believe in holy aspects; if not, their lives are poisoned
lives. Therefore, you see everywhere, in every house, people are using medicine, for what? To be in rest,
because people are saying, "Oh my head!" "Oh my tooth!" Who is not working for Allah, his organs are never
working!
People are not taking care, and never thinking, and the Holy Qur'an, perhaps more than a hundred times, is
calling people for thinking. Do not think about what Shaytan is giving to you, but you must think about holy
things. You must try to reach heavenly aspects, to be happy. Happiness comes from the Heavens! You can't
find happiness, rest, comfort, pleasure, and sweetness from earthly aspects, no! All prophets came to make
people live a sweet life. A sweet life is dressing them with heavenly pleasure. Why are you not running to take
it? But people are going to be such foolish ones, thinking that sweetness or pleasure is only with gold, silver,

or millions or billions of pounds, dollars, or euros, no! You must think on it! If you are not thinking, your life
is going to be such a dark life with no rest and no taste for what you eat, drink, dress, or ride with your ladies
and children, no! There is no pleasure or sweet life for them, never!
We are saying this, but our egos are always asking to refuse. Our ego is the best friend of Shaytan, saying, "O
my best friend, Diabolo" People are cheated by one Shaytan, cheating billions and billions of people. They
never like to listen to or learn from the 124,000 prophets and the Seal of Prophets (s), who brought
everything for the happiness of Mankind here and for Paradise, the Next Life! Astaghfirullah. Astaghfirullah.
We must ask for forgiveness from Allah Almighty and we must ask, "O our Lord! Send us the sultan!" If there
is no sultan, there will be no peace on Earth. The whole world now is in endless troubles, and there is no rest.
Everywhere you find people are unhappy and in khawf, fear. They don't know what is going to happen up to
Maghrib, and if they reach nighttime, they do not know what will happen up to morning. Such darkness is
coming on people because they sent away their sultans and kings, and they took Shaytan and its followers or
agents as their rulers. How is Shaytan going to rule people? By directing them to Hell!
Now everywhere there are troubles, and every 24 hours the TV is showing that people in the east and west are
not happy, quarreling, fighting, killing, destroying, and burning, and for what? Because they sent away
sultans. The sultan is the head of the community; your feet are not going to be your sultan, no! They replaced
the heads (leaders) with feet, and are trying to find a way to save themselves, but all of them are on the wrong
way! It is impossible for there to be peace if they are not changing their ways and restoring the sultans!
Everyday, every 24 hours, TV is broadcasting from east to west, from north to south, that all people are in
trouble, but they do not know. We say the parliament system is bankrupt, finished, so bring a sultan and
everything will be okay. If not, each one is going to kill the other. May Allah forgive us!
O People! O Muslim Territories! Allah Almighty ordered there should be one sultan. How many sultans are
there and how many presidents are there? What we are speaking of is Holy Shari`ah, that there should be a
khalifah on Earth (as the head). If you do not bring a sultan you will destroy everything on Earth through
killing and fighting. (For those who participate in that) finally, their graves will be engulfed in fire, filled with
snakes and every poisonous insect!
Allah, Allah. Today we are here, and tomorrow who knows if we will be here or not? Try to be servants of the

Lord, Almighty Allah. Yaa Rabb! This is shahr Muharram, an honored month, and today is the first Jumu`ah
of holy Muharram. Ask Allah Almighty to send us a sultan, to take away shaytanic groups and parliaments
and bring a sultan!
Bi jaahi man anzaltahu `alayhi Surat al-Fatihah.
